recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast close-up portrait of a male figure with stylized blue hair and dramatic makeup, set against a deep purple and magenta star-filled nebula. The composition features metallic, glowing typography at the top and a sharp, brush-stroke script at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The cool blue of the hair contrasts against the warm magenta and purple of the cosmic background.
The sharp, metallic texture of the top text mirrors the reflective highlights on the subject's skin and eyes.
The diagonal tilt of the head creates a dynamic line that leads the eye from the top-left text to the bottom-right script.
coreInvariants: Deep space nebula background with visible star clusters.
Dramatic, high-key lighting on the face with soft-focus skin texture.
Heavy, dark eye makeup with a hint of neon yellow/green inner-corner highlight.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally but tilted diagonally, occupying 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's intense gaze, specifically the eye on the left side of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large chrome header, follows the hand and hair down to the face, and ends at the script signature in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the corners are filled with dark cosmic textures to keep focus on the central figure.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and magenta (background and shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background and hair; high value (brightness) on the facial highlights for a 'glow' effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid earthy tones like brown or forest green.
Limit primary red; favor magenta and violet.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Wide, all-caps serif with internal beveling and outer cyan glow.
Bottom text: Aggressive, fast-motion brush strokes with sharp terminals and metallic gradients.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Serifs are elongated and sharpened to look like chrome spikes.
Script characters have 'speed lines' or dry-brush textures on the tails.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid, architectural chrome serifs and fluid, chaotic brush script.

candidateDirections.reason: Strong horizontal presence and sharp serifs match the header.
Aggressive, fast-moving strokes for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a person with electric blue hair and heavy glam makeup, hand near face with a spiked glove, against a purple and magenta nebula background with stars. Leave space at the top and bottom right for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a beveled chrome serif font with a cyan outer glow at the top. Apply a sharp, metallic brush script at the bottom right with a slight diagonal tilt.

verificationChecks: Is the top text beveled and glowing?
Does the hair color pop against the purple background?
Is the makeup high-contrast and sharp?
Is the bottom script legible but expressive?

mustRedesign: Generic portraits without the specific 'glam' makeup style.
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the chrome text has a distinct 3D bevel.
Check that the cyan glow doesn't wash out the letterforms.
Verify the skin texture is smooth but retains highlights.
Confirm the script text looks like it was painted with a metallic brush.
Check for visual balance between the two text blocks.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-fashion glam portrait with a 1980s-inspired cosmic backdrop and 2000s-era metallic digital typography.
